jobs.description:
Finance & Strategy

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steer Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

🎯 Your mission

As a member of the Strategy & planning team, your mission is to work closely with business teams and C-Level alaners to:

  • Build our business plan to exponentially increase Alan's enterprise value - profitable growth, margin expansion, cost efficiency. This includes deep-dives on go-to-market, on pricing & margin steering, on resource allocation, and on levers to increase our operating leverage.

  • Monitor Alan’s financial and operational performance to understand the value drivers, the opportunities, adjustments to bring to our plan. This implies a strong link with Finance production to build and automate monthly deep-dives

  • Steer performance through framing and implementing high-impact initiatives (e.g. procurement tool, pricing) and driving some punctual explorations (e.g. M&A, transformative partnerships, competitive intelligence)

  • Contribute to our investors relations and financing. This includes preparing Board meetings, fundraising, external communications.

To support the above, you will build, improve, maintain best-in-class tools for financial planning and performance monitoring, hand-in-hand with the Data, Business and Finance teams. This includes BP, monitoring dashboards, selection and implementation of third party tools where relevant.

You will also work closely with the Finance Operations teams, notably to produce and interpret our monthly financial performance, and on specific projects.

⚙️ Qualifications ⚙️

Must have

  • >1y experience in Management consulting or Investment Banking or similar experience at a top tech scale up

  • Excellence in Financial modeling

  • Excellent fluency in both English and French.

  • Passion/strong interest for getting close to other teams, to understand the operational details of their work and support them

    • Business (Sales, Operations, Insurance)

    • Data (support in defining metrics to build & monitor)

  • Experience in working with C-Levels

  • Being hands on: with our distributed ownership culture, you will drive projects end-to-end, from framing to building/implementing the tools, and communication

  • Thrive in exciting, high-intensity environment

Nice to have

  • Experience in Scale-up, SaaS, Insurance companies

  • SQL fluency

  • Accounting knowledge

For this role we are looking to hire within the C0-C1 level range.

 

🌍 How we work

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Meta product domain and help shape the experience that connects our games with the broader JustPlay platform.

At JustPlay, Meta is the layer between core gameplay and our rewards platform - including progress, rewards, boosters, LiveOps, and the experiences that connect each game to the wider JustPlay ecosystem. The Meta team owns this layer across our full game portfolio, extending platform features into games and building shared, reusable components that can be adopted across multiple titles. This helps us create a consistent player experience and scale new features across the portfolio without rebuilding them game by game.

In this role, you'll focus on making the JustPlay ecosystem feel seamless for players - identifying where the experience breaks between games and platform, turning those gaps into product opportunities, and setting direction around the solutions that can have the greatest impact on our key metrics. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and game teams to align around priorities, make trade-offs, and drive outcomes across the ecosystem.

What sets this role apart?

You'll be building for an entire portfolio of 50+ games, not just a single title. That means thinking in systems, balancing the needs of different games and player journeys, and shaping solutions that can scale across the JustPlay ecosystem.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, priorities, and key results for your area within the Meta domain

  • Identify and prioritise high-impact opportunities across the JustPlay ecosystem, balancing player needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

  • Drive complex product problems with a high degree of autonomy, from identifying the opportunity through launch, measurement, and iteration

  • Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Data game teams, and other Product team members to shape solutions, align on priorities, and bring impactful features to life.

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience within mobile or another B2C digital product, ideally with exposure to mobile games, gamification, loyalty, or rewards products.

  • Proven experience owning a product area or domain, including strategy, prioritization, key results, and measurable outcomes

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using data to make product decisions and evaluate impact

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, particularly Engineering, Design, and Data

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing priorities and adapting as new information emerges

Build a Safer World.

Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is hiring a Senior Capture Manager (UK) to support our most complex, high-impact deals, with an initial focus on public sector opportunities.

This is not a traditional proposal writer or reactive Deal Desk role. The Senior Capture Manager will operate upstream in the sales cycle, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Legal, Security, and RevOps to shape deal strategy, influence decision criteria, and improve win probability before formal procurement begins.

This role exists to increase quality, speed, and consistency across complex deals — while reducing risk, rework, and late-stage friction.

  • Own capture strategy for PubSec opportunities globally and strategic public sector deals

  • Engage early in the sales cycle (pre-RFP where possible) to:

    • Shape requirements and evaluation criteria

    • Influence Statements of Work and procurement language

    • Align pricing, scope, and structure with long-term deal success

  • Act as a strategic advisor to AEs on deal positioning, ROMs, and proposal framing

Proposal Quality & Risk Management

  • Lead capture execution for complex opportunities:

    • Translate customer intent into compliant, outcome-driven proposals

    • Ensure responses accurately reflect customer needs, constraints, and procurement realities

  • Reduce late-stage surprises by identifying risk early and guiding teams through mitigation strategies

    • Sales

    • Product & Engineering

    • Legal

    • Security & IT

    • Finance & RevOps

  • Triage what requires escalation vs. what can be resolved within Deal Desk

  • Ensure the right teams are engaged at the right time — no earlier, no later

Enablement & Continuous Improvement

  • Build reusable capture templates, artifacts, and best practices

  • Codify learnings from wins and losses to improve future deal execution

Qualifications

TRM Speed

  • Tech Stack & Automation: Optimized Salesforce workflows and integrated CPQ automation in under 48 hours, eliminating manual data entry and accelerating deal approvals by 3x.

  • Revenue Planning & Strategy: Led a full-scale territory realignment in just three days, ensuring seamless execution and zero downtime for the sales team while improving coverage efficiency.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer — AI-Native Engineering (XTM Foundation)

🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran.

We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey.

You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast.

  • Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce.

  • Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond.

  • Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures.

  • Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours.

  • Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone.

  • Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team.

  • Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO.

  • Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, experimentation, standards) and direct collaboration with product teams to embed AI practices in real engineering workflows.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience — you are a strong engineer first. You understand what good code looks like, and that's what makes your judgment on AI credible.

  • You are genuinely AI-first in how you work. Not as a trend, not as a productivity hack. You've already transformed how you build software, you can show what you built and what you measured, and you want to help others do the same.

  • Proven experience deploying AI-assisted development practices within an engineering team: you've done this before, you know what resistance looks like, and you know what actually works and what doesn't.

  • Deep, hands-on familiarity with the current AI coding tooling landscape: agentic coding tools, LLM-powered code review, prompt engineering for development workflows, MCP ecosystems, and what's coming next.

  • Strong full-stack engineering background — you can evaluate AI output across the whole stack and contribute code yourself when it matters.

  • You can make a clear case, with evidence. You're a natural communicator who can discuss a trade-off with a skeptical senior engineer just as well as you can help a junior developer get started.

  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, async culture with teams across multiple time zones; clear communicator in English.

  • Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive this agenda without waiting for direction, and you bring others with you rather than working alone.

  • Bonus: experience with open-source communities, cybersecurity domain knowledge, contributions to AI tooling projects, or public writing/speaking on AI-Native engineering.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

  • Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

  • Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

  • Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

  • Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

  • Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

  • Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

  • Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

jobs.description:
Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Creative Agents

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

  • Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

  • Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

  • Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

  • Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

  • Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

  • Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

  • Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives.

You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls.

  • Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements.

  • Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records.

  • Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines.

  • Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation.

  • Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions.

  • Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve.

  • Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.

  • Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.

Who you are

  • Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.

  • Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.

  • Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation.

  • Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams.

  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus.

  • Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Enterprise Customer Success Manager

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This role is a remote position open to candidates residing in Germany. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

Will require travel to customer sites in Germany, The Netherlands and the United Kingdom, for up to 20% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether a customer achieves their sustainability goals, or whether power gets restored quickly after an incident
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Fluency in German required

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Trade Compliance Analyst

Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Trade Compliance Analyst to join our fast-growing team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support daily customs, import, export, RMA, procurement, shipping, and customer due diligence workflows.
  • Coordinate routine customs matters with brokers, freight forwarders, Shipping, Logistics, Procurement, Supply Chain, RMA, and Sales, escalating off-nominal issues as appropriate.
  • Review import and shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, entry records, broker inquiries, and related customs documents.
  • Support HTS classification work by reviewing product information, proposing classifications for review, maintaining records, and gathering supporting information from suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Gather and maintain country of origin, manufacturer, COTS classification, valuation, product description, and other import-related information.
  • Support export control reviews by gathering facts related to products, technology, destinations, end users, end uses, parties, and transaction structure.
  • Assist with customer due diligence using Dow Jones Risk Center, including restricted party screening, red flag review, and documentation of results.
  • Support export license applications and other authorizations by gathering inputs, records, and supporting documentation.

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in customs compliance, trade compliance, import/export operations, logistics compliance, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with HTS classification, country of origin, valuation, customs brokers, entry documents, and shipping documentation.
  • Working knowledge of the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
  • Familiarity with restricted party screening, customer due diligence, end-use/end-user red flags, and sanctions-related transaction review.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-up, and recordkeeping skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple transactional requests and escalate compliance issues clearly and timely.
  • Experience with SNAP-R, DECCS or supporting export license applications and other export authorizations.

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

  • S. Customs Broker License or significant hands-on customs/import compliance experience.
  • Aerospace, defense, radar, electronics, hardware manufacturing, or government contracting experience.
  • Experience with Dow Jones Risk Center or similar restricted party screening / due diligence tools.
  • Experience with Arena, NetSuite, Trello, or similar business systems.

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Finoa, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.

Direct Search ist dein Spielfeld. Du findest die Menschen, die gerade gar nicht suchen, aber genau die Richtigen für Aampere wären. Über LinkedIn, GitHub, Communities und alles, was dir sonst noch einfällt.

Why Aampere?

Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen

Senior Account Manager:in (w/m/d)

Kunden erinnern sich an Menschen. Nicht an Angebote.Kunden erinnern sich an Menschen. Nicht an Angebote.


Wofür wir dich suchen

Identity & Access Management gehört zu den Themen, die heute auf keiner IT-Agenda mehr fehlen. Unternehmen müssen digitale Identitäten schützen, Zugriffe steuern und Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen. Dahinter steckt aber mehr als Technologie. Es geht um Vertrauen. Um Zusammenarbeit. Und um Partner, die ihre Kunden langfristig begleiten.
Als Senior Account Manager:in (w/m/d) übernimmst du dabei eine zentrale Rolle. Du baust Beziehungen auf, verstehst Herausforderungen, erkennst Potenziale und bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen. Gemeinsam mit unseren Experten entwickelst du Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen und unsere Kunden langfristig begleiten.
Wer Freude daran hat, Kunden erfolgreich zu machen, findet bei der ipg den passenden Platz.


Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen im Umfeld Identity & Access Management
  • Aufbau neuer Kontakte und Partnerschaften sowie die Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Identifikation von Bedarfen und Potenzialen bei Bestands- und Neukunden
  • Entwicklung kundenindividueller Lösungsansätze gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Expert:innen
  • Erstellung und Verhandlung von Angeboten bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss
  • Die verständliche Präsentation unserer Dienstleistungen und Lösungen gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern
  • Beobachtung von Markt- und Technologietrends sowie deren Einbringung in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebsstrategie


Was du mitbringst

  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse im Bereich Identity & Access Management oder angrenzenden Security-Themen
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management, IT-Vertrieb oder Solution Sales
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und kundenorientiert zu vermitteln

Bist du bereit?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Menschen, die Kunden nicht nur gewinnen, sondern langfristig begleiten möchten.
Menschen, die Geschäftsmöglichkeiten erkennen, bevor sie offensichtlich werden.
Und Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft von Identity & Access Management gestalten möchten.


Was wir dir bieten

Womit wir dir einen echten Mehrwert bieten:

  • Ein attraktives und leistungsorientiertes Vergütungspaket 
  • Ein vielfältiges und spannendes Aufgabenspektrum mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Ein professionelles und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Ein umfangreiches Angebot an Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Optionen
  • Zusätzliche Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsförderung, etc.
 Was für uns selbstverständlich ist und Ausdruck unserer WIR-Kultur:
  • Mobiles und flexibles Arbeiten sorgt für deine optimale Work-Life Integration
  • Regelmäßige Aus- und Weiterbildungen und Förderung individueller Zertifizierungen bringen dich weiter
  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Sonderurlaub und individuelle Sabbatical Regelungen bieten dir Auszeit und Entspannung
  • Die Hardware kannst du auch für private Zwecke nutzen
  • Softgetränke sowie Kaffee und Tee kriegst du bei uns kostenlos
  • Großartige Firmenevents machen unsere Kultur für dich erlebbar


Über uns

Seit mehr als 20 Jahren ist die IPG Pionier und Experte im Bereich Identity & Access Management und Governance. Namhafte Kunden aller Branchen wie auch Organisationen der öffentlichen Verwaltung in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Österreich vertrauen auf den Service und die Expertise von IPG für einen umfassenden Schutz von Benutzerdaten sowie Zugriffs- und Zutrittsrechten.

Mit mehr als 1.700 Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten wir in 25 Städten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie in Niederlassungen in Italien, den Niederlanden, Spanien und den USA. Werkstudent:in Lead Generation
Das sind wir

Seit 2000 macht die ITA Logistics Group den Versand für Unternehmen einfacher, transparenter und effizienter. Mit unseren Plattformen LetMeShip und ParcelParcel können Unternehmen ihren täglichen Versand schnell vergleichen und direkt buchen. Dabei bündeln wir zahlreiche Versanddienstleister auf unseren Plattformen und kombinieren moderne Technologie mit persönlichem Service.


An mehreren Standorten in Europa arbeiten unsere Teams täglich daran, Versandprozesse nachhaltig zu vereinfachen. Wir setzen auf offene Zusammenarbeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten.


Deine Rolle

Deine 20 Stunden bei uns verbringst du vor allem damit, neue Unternehmen anzusprechen und erste Kontakte zu potenziellen Kunden aufzubauen. Dafür stellen wir dir bereits Leadlisten mit interessanten Unternehmen zur Verfügung. Gleichzeitig recherchierst du auch selbst, welche weiteren Unternehmen gut zu LetMeShip passen könnten, ermittelst die richtigen Ansprechpartner und greifst zum Hörer.

Mal erreichst du sofort die passende Person, mal brauchst du mehrere Anläufe. Du lernst, Gespräche zu eröffnen, zuzuhören und echtes Interesse zu erkennen.

Dein Ziel ist es, einen gut vorbereiteten Präsentationstermin für unsere Sales Manager zu vereinbaren. Dafür hältst du fest, was das Unternehmen versendet, welche Anforderungen bestehen und welche Fragen im ersten Gespräch aufgekommen sind. Im anschließenden Präsentationstermin übernimmt unser Sales Manager, stellt LetMeShip ausführlich vor, zeigt die Vorteile und Funktionen unserer Plattform und geht konkret auf den individuellen Versandbedarf des Unternehmens ein. Du gehörst zum Sales Team und bist dabei auch mit unserem Customer Service im Austausch.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest mit von uns bereitgestellten Leadlisten und ergänzt diese durch eigene Recherche nach passenden potenziellen Geschäftskunden und den richtigen Ansprechpersonen.

  • Du greifst zum Telefon, erreichst die zuständigen Personen und stellst LetMeShip kurz vor.

  • Du fragst nach den bisherigen Versandabläufen, verschaffst dir einen ersten Überblick über den Bedarf und erkennst, bei welchen Unternehmen echtes Interesse besteht.

  • Du hältst die wichtigsten Informationen und Gesprächsergebnisse in HubSpot fest und sorgst so für eine gut vorbereitete Übergabe an unsere Sales Manager.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist immatrikuliert und kannst neben deinem Studium 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten.

  • Du kannst regelmäßig in unserem Hamburger Office arbeiten. Bei uns bedeutet hybrid: drei Tage im Office und zwei Tage flexibel im Homeoffice.

  • Du möchtest Erfahrungen im Vertrieb sammeln und hast keine Scheu vor vielen Telefonaten mit unbekannten Menschen.

  • Du kannst dich auf unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner einstellen und fragst nach, wenn du etwas genauer verstehen möchtest.

  • Absagen gehören für dich zur Akquise dazu. Du gehst danach mit neuer Energie ins nächste Gespräch.

  • Du organisierst deine Kontakte sorgfältig und drückst dich auf Deutsch mündlich und schriftlich sehr gut aus.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

BWL auf dem Stundenplan? Passt. Meeresbiologie oder zeitgenössische Puppenspielkunst? Passt auch. Für uns zählt weniger dein Studienfach als deine Lust, mit Menschen ins Gespräch zu kommen. Vertriebserfahrung sind für uns nicht entscheidend. Wir zeigen dir unsere Plattformen und geben dir das Wissen mit, das du für deine ersten Gespräche brauchst.


Warum ITA Logistics Group?

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind und Feedback nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, arbeiten agil und entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter. Dazu gehört für uns auch der Einsatz moderner digitaler Tools und KI-Anwendungen, die deinen Arbeitsalltag sinnvoll unterstützen und Prozesse effizienter machen.

Deine Vorteile 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeiten

  • Zeiterfassung & Überstundenausgleich

  • Deutschlandticket oder Parkplatz-Zuschuss

  • SpenditCard mit monatlich 50 € Guthaben

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Corporate Benefits Programm

  • Workation-Möglichkeit

  • Beratung & Unterstützung durch das Fürstenberg Institut


Dein Start 
 
Ein strukturierter Onboarding-Prozess sorgt dafür, dass du dich von Anfang an gut zurecht findest. Du lernst Schritt für Schritt unsere Teams, Prozesse und Plattformen kennen und kannst dich schnell in deine neue Rolle einbringen.
 
Mehr Informationen findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.


Werde Teil der ITA Crew

Klingt gut? Dann freuen sich Felix und Björn auf deine Bewerbung inklusive Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Startdatum.

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aller Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder Religion.

Bewerber:innen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.


+49 15888 279908


If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

  • Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions
