CDI - Responsable d'atelier & Bureau d'étude H/F

Sous la responsabilité de la Directrice du Studio Collection, vous participez au développement de nos collections PAP Homme/Femme et projets VIP.

Sous la responsabilité du Directeur de Production, vous êtes le garant du bien aller du vêtement et assurez la normalisation des modèles.

Connaissance des normes de qualité et de sécurité.

Riche d’une expérience en modélisme d’au moins 7 ans, vous montrez une forte sensibilité pour l'univers créatif de la maison AMI. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.

jobs.title: Alternant·e Growth Marketing Manager | Thiga Academy
jobs.description:
Alternant·e Growth Marketing Manager | Thiga Academy
Alternance · Paris 9e · Télétravail · rythme d’alternance souhaité 3 semaines entreprise / 1 semaine école 
 
Thiga en 30 secondes : 

Thiga est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en IA et en digital. Nous accompagnons les plus grands groupes et scale-ups françaises : Decathlon, Doctolib, AXA, ManoMano, Mirakl, Disney, Leboncoin et une centaine d'autres. Nous sommes 200, majoritairement à Paris.
Thiga Academy, c'est notre organisme de formation. On y forme les équipes produit (Product Managers, Product Owners, Designers, Product Leaders) et celles qui veulent le devenir : product management, product discovery, leadership produit, et IA appliquée au produit. En inter-entreprise comme en intra, on transmet ce que nos consultants pratiquent chez nos clients tous les jours
 
Pourquoi ce poste : 

L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite.

C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir.


Ce que tu vas faire 🖇

1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing & Events

  • Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription

  • Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas

  • Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée

  • Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA

  • Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com

  • Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister

  • Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence

    • 2. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer

    Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires.

  • Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions

  • Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne

  • Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater

  • Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions

    • 3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel

    L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel.

  • Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA

  • Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable

    • L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous, c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique.


    La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰

    Le growth marketing moderne, c'est une combinaison d'intuition testée par la donnée, de vitesse d'exécution et de bons outils au bon moment.

  • LLM et agents : Claude (Pro et Code), Gemini

  • Génération visuelle et audio : Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, HeyGen

  • Marketing ops : HubSpot (CRM, marketing hub, workflows), Luma, Phantom Buster

  • Prise de notes et capitalisation : Granola, Notion AI

  • Vibe coding (en bonus, pour les profils qui veulent aller plus loin) : Lovable, Cursor pour bricoler des micro-outils internes

    • Tu n'as pas besoin de tout maîtriser à l'arrivée. On attend une vraie curiosité et l'envie de pratiquer, pas un CV exhaustif.


    Le profil que nous recherchons 🌟

  • Formation : école de commerce ou de communication, en M1 ou M2, idéalement avec une spécialisation marketing, growth ou entrepreneuriat

  • Pratique IA personnelle prouvée : tu as un side project, un compte ChatGPT ou Claude que tu utilises tous les jours, un workflow Make ou n8n que tu as construit, un agent custom, un blog assisté par LLM, un repo GitHub, ou n'importe quoi qui démontre que l'IA est dans ta vie.

  • Réflexe growth : tu penses en funnel avant de penser en campagne, tu formules des hypothèses avant de produire, et tester puis mesurer te vient plus naturellement que produire pour produire

  • Appétence data : Excel ou Google Sheets n'ont pas de secret pour toi, et l'idée de creuser un dashboard pour comprendre pourquoi un taux de conversion a bougé t'intéresse plus qu'elle ne t'ennuie

  • Fibre communication : tu sais écrire pour être lu, tu as déjà animé une page, un compte ou une communauté

  • Rigueur opérationnelle et sens du détail : tu sais qu'une séquence email qui commence par « Bonjour {prénom} », ça fait tâche, et qu'un A/B test mal cadré ne prouve rien

  • Sensibilité business : tu comprends les concepts MQL, CAC, NPS, et tu sais qu'une belle campagne ne vaut rien si elle ne remplit pas les sessions

    • Au-delà des hard skills, on recherche surtout quelqu’un de curieux, volontaire, débrouillard et qui n’a pas peur de proposer des nouvelles idées !


    Ce qu'on offre 🎊

  • Stack IA premium : Claude, Gemini, et accès facilité à tous les outils IA quand ils sont pertinents pour ton travail

  • Encadrement et présence au quotidien de membres de l'équipe marketing pointus sur les sujets growth, événementiel et IA

  • Cadence de suivi : 1-to-1 hebdomadaire avec le Head of Marketing & Events. Fonctionnement quotidien en équipe avec les autres Head of (Content, Design) et le CMO

  • Cadre de travail : bureaux 23 rue Taitbout (Paris 9), équipe marketing de 8 personnes

  • Rémunération : grille légale alternance, transparente dès l'entretien


    • Le process 🎢

    Envoie ton CV, un lien vers un side project ou portfolio (même bricolé). Pas de lettre de motivation.

    En termes de déroulé, tu auras : 

  • Un premier call avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager

  • Un échange avec le Head of Marketing & Event 

  • Un case study à préparer et présenter 

  • Un dernier entretien avec Hugo, notre CEO

    • Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

jobs.description:
Chef de projets sénior - Opérations H/F/X CDI
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Responsable hiérarchique : 

Vous êtes directement rattaché à la Directrice de la Performance des Opérations Groupe, et serez intégré à l’équipe projet existante.

Environnement de travail : 

Le poste de Chef de projet est basé au siège à St Denis proche de nos entrepôts en Ile de France.

Des déplacements sur les sites opérationnels du Groupe sont à prévoir en fonction du besoin (Ile de France, région Lyonnaise et en Espagne à côté de Barcelone).


🎯 MISSIONS

Au sein de la direction des Opérations, le/la Chef de Projet Opérations joue un rôle stratégique dans la transformation de notre Supply Chain.

Votre mission consiste à piloter les projets de bout en bout : 

  • de la phase d’étude : démarche de résolution de problème, structuration de la réflexion et des points à investiguer, collecte de données, analyses,  design de la solution, évaluation de l’impact des solutions proposées et comment elles répondent à la question traitée, chiffrage du business case pour aider à  la prise de décision

  • jusqu'au déploiement complet et réussi des solutions retenues pour les projets validés passant en phase d'implémentation : gestion des interlocuteurs, conduite du changement, gestion du planning, suivi du budget, gestion de la gouvernance projet…

  • étude capacitaire de notre réseau logistique (network design)

  • optimisation des processus logistiques et du plan d’implémentation de nos entrepôts

  • recherche de solutions d’automatisation de nos entrepôts


    • 👉 PRÉ REQUIS

    Expertise Technique et Logistique

  • Excellente culture logistique et une expertise pointue de l'environnement intralogistique (connaissance approfondie des entrepôts et des flux).

  • Automatisation et Robotique : Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans l'automatisation d'entrepôts. Vous êtes particulièrement au fait des dernières technologies de robotisation (AMR, AGV, systèmes goods-to-person) exploitant l'Intelligence Artificielle.

  • Design et modélisation : Vous maîtrisez les concepts de design de réseau logistique et de layout d'entrepôt (la maîtrise d'outils de type AutoCAD ou logiciels de simulation est un plus).

  • Finance de projet : Vous êtes parfaitement à l'aise avec la création et la soutenance de business cases complexes.

  • Français et un très bon niveau d’anglais indispensables, Espagnol est un vrai plus

    •  

    Compétences comportementales : 

  • Leadership naturel et capacité à embarquer des équipes transverses.

  • Esprit hautement analytique orienté vers la résolution de problèmes (problem-solving).

  • Excellente communication orale et écrite

  • Proactivité et dynamisme

  • Volonté de s’inscrire dans une démarche de succès collectif 

    •  

    Formation et expérience professionnelles 

  • Niveau et type de formation initiale : de formation supérieure en École d’ingénieure/école de commerce.

  • Expérience professionnelle: expérience > 7 ans sur un emploi similaire au sein d’une Direction des Opérations ou en conseil spécialisé en Opérations/Supply Chain avec une très bonne connaissance des sujets logistiques.


    • ✅ AVANTAGES
  • 👉Prime variable

jobs.title: Team Leader Aftersales - Retention & Key Account Management
jobs.description:
Team Leader Aftersales - Retention & Key Account Management

Prenez les commandes de la rétention et de la protection des comptes stratégiques du n°1 européen de la beauté & du bien-être.

Chez Treatwell, nous aidons des millions de clients à « exprimer leur beauté » et plus de 95 000 salons partenaires en Europe à faire grandir leur activité. Plus grande marketplace de réservation beauté & bien-être du continent, présente dans 14 pays, nous équipons aussi les instituts d'un logiciel de gestion qui digitalise leur quotidien. La rétention et la protection de nos comptes les plus stratégiques sont au cœur de notre capacité à défendre notre part de marché, et c'est vous que nous cherchons pour en prendre la tête.

Votre mission

À la tête de 3 Experts Rétention et 2 Key Account Managers, vous faites de la France la référence du groupe : une machine de rétention scalable et prévisible, et un Key Account Management qui devient le moteur d'expansion de nos comptes premium.

01 — Piloter la machine de rétention

Protéger le portefeuille et nos parts de marché.

  • Bon portefeuille & bon niveau de risque : cartographier le portefeuille France selon le risque réel de churn et arbitrer l'effort entre comptes volume et comptes premium.
  • Playbook vivant : arguments de rétention, gestion des objections, upsell et cross-sell, critères d'escalade clairs.
  • Signaux faibles : agir sur les comptes à risque avant la résiliation, pas en fin de mois.

02 — Structurer et faire grandir le Key Account Management

Faire de nos comptes les plus stratégiques un levier de croissance durable.

  • Bon périmètre & bons objectifs : salons à forte valeur ajoutée (pas nécessairement des chaînes) et partenaires stratégiques, avec des objectifs clairs de croissance.
  • QBR data-driven : des revues trimestrielles qui débouchent sur des plans d'action concrets : upsell (site web, Tap to Pay…), ouvertures, renouvellements, Treatwell Business Days.
  • Bons leviers de négociation : commissions, frais et contreparties par paliers de revenus, exceptions arbitrées avec Pricing / Revenue, et lead sur les négociations en escalade sans déposséder le KAM.

03 — Piloter par la donnée

Fabriquer le résultat par un rythme rigoureux et des chiffres fiables.

  • Centre de profit : obsession du taux de rétention, du churn, du NRR, de l'ARPU et de la TTV.
  • Forecast « no-surprise » : prévisions de churn et d'upsell, pilotage par les indicateurs avancés.
  • Tech stack : un CRM (Salesforce) sans friction et une donnée de qualité sur le churn et ses motifs.

04 — Manager une équipe de haute performance

Des standards sans compromis et une équipe qui grandit.

  • Leadership par l'exemple : mener depuis l'arène, avec une culture « No-Excuse » & « No-Asshole ».
  • Sales & Retention Academy : 1-to-1, revues d'appels et un onboarding qui amène chaque recrue à pleine productivité.
  • « High bar » & « One Team » : recruter haut, développer les hauts potentiels et travailler main dans la main avec Sales, Produit et Marketing.

Requirements

  • Expérience confirmée en management d'équipe, idéalement en environnement B2B, SaaS ou orienté client.
  • Expérience solide en rétention, Customer Success ou Key Account Management ; la double culture est un vrai plus.
  • Un(e) leader de terrain qui pilote par la donnée, avec un track record de structuration (process, playbooks, onboarding).
  • Français courant et aisance en anglais.

Benefits

  • Impact réel : un vrai mandat sur les comptes les plus stratégiques de Treatwell France.
  • Package : fixe 40-45K€ + variable indicatif 20K€.
  • Cadre de travail : Paris, hybride, 28 jours de congés, tickets restaurant, Gymlib, 40€/mois sur l'app Treatwell.

Egalité des chances

Treatwell est un employeur “Ouvert à tous” et accueille chaleureusement tout le monde dans son équipe. Nous nous engageons à apporter des aménagements raisonnables au processus de recrutement selon les besoins. Merci d’indiquer toute demande d’ajustement lors de votre candidature.

Envie de mener la danse ?

Si diriger et faire grandir une équipe de haut niveau vous fait vibrer, parlons-en.

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

  • Erfahrung in einem produzierenden oder industriellen Umfeld, idealerweise im Maschinenbau, in der Automatisierungstechnik oder im projektorientierten Geschäft

jobs.description:
Associate Director/ Director FP&A EMEA

Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

 
Summary of Position:

Reporting to the VP, Finance EMEA, the Associate Director/ Director, FP&A will support Scholar Rock’s EMEA organization. The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of planning and delivering against financial objectives in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.

In this role, they will serve as a strategic partner in framing, evaluating, and driving decisions to maximize value creation. Success will require clear communication, strong organization, and a collaborative mindset.

This position offers an opportunity to help build a critical cross-functional capability within a growing, evolving, multi-product candidate biotechnology company.


Position Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary finance partner for the EMEA scope across revenue and OPEX planning.
  • Support FP&A activities including budgeting and forecasting, long-range planning, scenario modeling, and financial analysis for strategic initiatives.
  • Build and maintain patient and revenue models, ensuring appropriate underlying assumptions for direct and partner markets.
  • Partner with EMEA Accounting on month-end and quarter-end close activities, quarterly schedules, procure-to-pay processes, and support for external reporting and audit inquiries.
  • Deliver timely monthly budget-to-actual analyses, including variance analysis and management reporting.
  • Drive continuous improvement of FP&A processes to increase efficiency while maintaining flexibility to meet evolving business needs.
  • Develop and deliver training and change-management support to drive adoption of new FP&A tools, systems, and ways of working across the organization.
  • Support ad hoc strategic initiatives as business needs arise, including business development analyses, partner support, portfolio prioritization, and financing strategies.

  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of progressive finance experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Advanced degree in science and/or business preferred.

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
Agentic Product Manager

About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.

This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.

We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

  • Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

  • Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

  • Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

  • Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

  • Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

  • Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

  • Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

  • Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

  • Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

  • Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

  • Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

  • Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

  • Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

  • Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

  • Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand

  • Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them

  • Are energized by having a lot of ownership and working closely with smart, mission-driven teammates

  • Are able to work on-site from our Zurich office

  • Bonus: You have legal domain familiarity, or experience in search and knowledge management, agentic search and data retrieval, or LegalTech – or you’ve worked in/with law firms, legal departments, or regulated industries

What you can look forward to:

  • A high-impact role in shaping a product and company with huge potential

  • The chance to work on the cutting edge of long-horizon agentic AI, applied to real-world legal work

  • A strong, technical, and collaborative team that’s serious about building great software

  • A culture that encourages experimentation, curiosity, and thoughtful decision-making

Submit your application by October 16th. Our team will review all candidates after the closing date and reach out regarding next steps.

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare
jobs.description:
Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
In healthcare, the phone is still the front door, and call volume keeps rising while the people answering it are harder to hire and keep. You'll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run. You'll have the mandate to build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

  • Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment

  • Build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales team

  • Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies

  • Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one

  • Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run

  • Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling

Applied AI Engineer

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're building agents that run real parts of our business, take on real work, and get better based on the results they produce. You'll build them with whatever is most capable right now: our own agents platform, the latest orchestration tools, and frontier models. The hard part is making them reliable, measurable, and safe enough for the business to depend on.

You'll sit in Marketing Engineering and be forward-deployed to our growth pods, where you'll find the problems worth solving and own the solutions end to end. You might be a forward-deployed builder, an applied AI engineer who has taken agents beyond the demo stage, or a full-stack engineer who is curious about growth.

jobs.title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

  • You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations.

  • You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements.

  • You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

  • Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products.

  • Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

  • Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you!

jobs.title: Senior Process Engieer
jobs.description:
Senior Process Engieer
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.

troubleshooting.

and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.

that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.

future plant designs.

validation for new equipment and plant expansions.

design intent.

systems achieve their calculated performance targets.

transfers once the process meets its design criteria.

Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.
4. The role requires regular on-site presence in Gendorf, with an expectation of approximately 2 days per week on average. Depending on project needs and plant activities, some weeks may require more on-site presence, while others may require less.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.

Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.

mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.

into engineering models and decisions.

hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.

documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
jobs.description:
Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives

About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with Digital Native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

  • Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

  • Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

  • Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

  • Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

  • Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

  • Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

  • Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering—not only program or stakeholder management.

  • Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

  • Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

  • Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

  • Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)

As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

jobs.description:
Head of Crypto

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As the Head of Crypto, you will be the driving force behind a brand new, core pillar of Satispay's expansion into the cryptocurrency and Web3 space. We already have a high-potential strategy in place—your mission is to take the reins, execute it flawlessly, adapt it when necessary, and expand upon it wherever possible.

Given the strategic importance of this initiative to Satispay, you will work with a high degree of autonomy and have direct, frequent touchpoints with the Satispay founding team to align on execution, team scaling, and long-term vision.

Here’s what that looks like in practice:

  • Hire & Build Your Team: Identify talent needs, recruit, and structure a dedicated, high-performing cross-functional team from the ground up to bring Satispay's crypto vertical to life.

  • Execution & Strategic Evolution: Take ownership of our existing crypto roadmap. Drive its execution to deliver immediate impact, while continuously evaluating the market to make necessary adjustments and expand our offerings when new opportunities arise.

  • Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders and C-level executives to ensure the crypto rollout continuously aligns with the company's ultimate mission to simplify everyday finance.

  • Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our crypto products—from infrastructure setup and go-to-market strategy to launch and continuous optimization.

  • Regulatory Navigation: Work in lockstep with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure all products align perfectly with evolving European regulations (such as MiCA) and safeguarding standards.

  • Strategic Partnerships: Identify and establish crucial relationships with key players in the crypto ecosystem, including exchanges, custodians, liquidity providers, and blockchain networks.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

What we're looking for

We are seeking for an execution-focused, and product-minded leader with a deep passion for digital assets that matches our company culture.

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 initiatives at a regulated Fintech, exchange, or crypto-native company.

  • Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment.

We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

jobs.description:
Senior Sales Operations Manager

About the Role

At NetBox Labs, we're building the future of network automation. Our products power network and infrastructure management for thousands of organizations, from fast-growing startups to global Fortune 500 enterprises.

We’re hiring a Sr. Sales Operations Manager to help drive operational rigor, visibility, and execution across our global sales organization. This role will partner closely with Sales leadership to improve how we manage pipeline, forecasting, territories, account coverage, rep productivity, and overall sales performance. You’ll help establish scalable sales processes, translate data into actionable insights, and give sales leaders the visibility they need to identify gaps and improve execution. This role will also work closely with the Revenue Operations Managers on HubSpot administration, GTM systems architecture, and the integration stack.

This is a highly analytical and hands-on role for someone who can translate sales data into actionable insights, build scalable operating processes, and help sales leaders identify and address gaps in execution. You’ll play a key role in establishing the operational foundation and cadence needed to support a growing sales organization.

What you'll do

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Revenue Operations Managers to manage and continuously improve forecasting, pipeline management, and sales operating cadences.

  • Build and maintain reporting that provides visibility into pipeline coverage, conversion, sales productivity, attainment, deal progression, and forecast accuracy.

  • Analyze sales performance to identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve execution.

  • Support territory design, account segmentation, capacity planning, and account ownership processes.

  • Partner with Sales leadership on quarterly and annual planning, including targets, coverage models, and resource allocation.

  • Drive consistent sales processes and stage management across the organization, including opportunity hygiene and pipeline inspection.

  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, and analyses that enable sales leaders to make faster, data-driven decisions.

  • Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations on quota, headcount, productivity, and performance analysis.

  • Support the operational rollout of new sales processes, programs, and initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify seller workflows and improve rep productivity through process, automation, and technology.

  • Partner with Enablement to translate process changes and operational insights into seller training and adoption.

  • Maintain documentation for sales processes, rules of engagement, territory structures, and operating cadences.

  • Serve as a trusted operational partner to Sales leadership and frontline managers.

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS company, including time at sub-$50M ARR where you built the process rather than inherited it

  • Owned the forecast and pipeline motion end to end, including territory and quota design, coverage modeling, and rep productivity analysis

  • Strong understanding of SaaS sales metrics, pipeline dynamics, conversion, coverage, and rep productivity.

  • Deep hands-on HubSpot and Salesforce including the ability to pull, model, and QA your own data without waiting on analytics

  • Built the reporting layer that sales leadership and the CFO actually run the business on, not dashboards that go unopened

  • Partnered directly with a CRO or VP Sales as a thought partner, and with frontline managers as a coach on their own numbers

  • Used AI and automation to remove manual work from the seller's day, with a specific example you can walk through

Our stack

  • CRM & Revenue Operations: HubSpot

  • Sales Intelligence & Prospecting: Apollo.io

  • Meeting Intelligence: Fathom

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

Your mission

This is not a normal job. Please read this part before you read anything else.

If you are highly driven, extremely ambitious, and you want to do the work of your life at a company that will change how people get access to new therapies and shared medical knowledge, mama health is the place for you.

If not, this role is not for you. This is why:

  • You will be in the office 5 days a week. Berlin HQ. Not hybrid. Not "flexible". We build together, in the same room, every day.

  • You will get obsessed with metrics. Not dashboards for a weekly meeting. Real obsession: why did this number move, what does it mean for a patient, what do we change tomorrow.

Why do we ask this much? Because today, patients spend years to reach the right therapy. We want to help every patient reach their best possible care faster: understand their own situation, get clear information about it, and get access to the best tools, therapies, and treatments in the world. This is generational work not work for everyone. It will change your life and the lives of millions of other people.


This role is built to grow into Head of Product. How fast depends on you.

As a Product Manager at mama health, you will shape and execute product of one of the most exciting AI companies in healthcare. You will work closely with the founders, engineers, designers, and medical experts to build products that help patients understand their diseases, and that help healthcare organizations learn directly from patient experiences at scale.

Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert.

In den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle

  • Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut

  • Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen

Danach

  • Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung

  • Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird

  • Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis

  • Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen

  • Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede

  • Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun


Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung

  • Du kannst ein Datenmodell beurteilen und eine Architekturdiskussion moderieren, ohne sie an dich zu reißen

  • Du willst wieder oder weiter Code schreiben, bevor du führst, und siehst das als Vorteil, nicht als Umweg

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in Messstellenbetrieb, Abrechnung, Marktkommunikation oder Mieterstrom. Du kennst Begriffe wie Messkonzept, MaLo oder OBIS nicht nur aus Wikipedia

  • Business-Verständnis: Du denkst vom Geschäftsmodell des Betreibers her, nicht vom Feature. Du kannst erklären, welche Anforderung Umsatz sichert, welche Risiko reduziert und welche nur schön ist

  • Du gibst direktes Feedback und hältst es aus, direktes Feedback zu bekommen

  • Du kannst Nein sagen, zu Stakeholdern und zum eigenen Team, und begründen, warum

  • Du fühlst dich in einem Startup wohl, in dem Strukturen noch entstehen und du sie mitgestaltest

  • Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, weil Fachlichkeit, Kunden und ein Großteil der Kommunikation deutsch sind


Warum wir?

  • Eine Führungsrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einer wachsenden Engineering-Organisation, mit einem Einstieg, der dich nicht ins kalte Wasser wirft

  • Direkter Draht zum CTO und Mitsprache bei der Teamstruktur, nicht nur bei der Umsetzung

jobs.description:
Research Engineer - Eval Platform

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Evaluation is how we decide which models, checkpoints and recipes ship. As a Research Engineer on the Eval Platform team, you will build the infrastructure every science team relies on to measure model quality, and make it reliable, reproducible and fast.

You don't need to have designed benchmarks before. You do need to care about what a score means, and about when a difference between two runs is real.

What you will do

  • Build systems that keep eval results reproducible and comparable over time, as models, benchmarks and code evolve.

  • Run evaluations at scale across our GPU clusters, from model serving to scoring.

  • Make eval results easy to access, explore and trust, through APIs and dashboards that researchers use every day.

  • Catch broken or noisy evals before they mislead research decisions.

  • Support evaluation of agentic, multi-turn and tool-using models.

  • Work closely with researchers to turn new evaluation needs into robust, shared tooling.

What we're looking for

  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • 4+ years building production-grade software, ideally large-scale ML codebases or distributed systems.

  • Excellent Python and strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

  • Experience running workloads on GPU clusters (Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray or similar).

  • Familiarity with LLM inference and evaluation.

  • A product mindset: researchers are your users.

  • Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or maintaining evaluation harnesses or benchmarks.

  • Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang.

  • Experience with agentic or RL environments.

  • Statistics for experimentation: variance estimation, significance testing.

  • Open-source contributions to ML tooling.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
Engineering Internships 2027

About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning

We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill.

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible)

Commitment: Internship-to-hire

What we Offer

  • Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products.

  • Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together.

  • Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter.

  • Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients

  • Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly.

We work across multiple domains:

  • Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX

  • Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs

  • Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems

Your DNA

  • Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field.

  • Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.

  • Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features.

  • Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn.

  • Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow.

Nice-to-Haves (but not required)

  • Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems.

  • Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing.

You’ll see us on campus at:

  • Télécom Paris

  • Forum Trium

  • ENSIMAG

  • CentraleSupélec

  • École Polytechnique

  • EPFL

  • Forum Organisation

Meet us there and tell us what excites you.

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.
