  • Data Governance: Establishes clear ownership, definitions, lineage, quality, security, and lifecycle controls without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Migration Leadership: Plans incremental transitions that protect customer reporting and production stability while retiring duplication and technical debt.

  • Ownership: Drives decisions through implementation, manages ambiguity, and remains accountable for platform adoption and results.
  • AI and Analytics Readiness: Designs governed, reusable data foundations suitable for advanced analytics and AI-enabled workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, database architecture, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, including 3+ years in a data architecture or senior technical leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience designing enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, or analytical platforms and migrating data from multiple operational systems.
  • Strong data-modeling expertise across conceptual, logical, and physical models, including dimensional modeling and normalized transactional designs.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Revenue Operations Manager

About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to strengthen the systems that power our go-to-market teams.

This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the processes, workflows, automations, and data architecture that accelerate how we find, engage, win, onboard, retain, and expand customers at scale. You will partner across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnership to turn fragmented systems and manual work into a high-leverage GTM engine.

If you naturally think: “This should be an automated system, not a spreadsheet.” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. We would love to connect with you about enabling our rapidly growing revenue team. You will play a key role in increasing internal efficiency and productivity to support the team in creating the best customer experience, and in driving commercial success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • CRM and revenue tech stack architecture

    • Own end-to-end CRM administration as the single source of truth for revenue activities

    • Manage the design, configuration, and roadmap of a connected revenue tech stack

    • Set and enforce data governance standards: field hygiene, deduplication, permissions, and ongoing data-quality monitoring

  • Automation and data foundation

    • Automate and enrich the manual layer with workflows and LLMs

    • Build and maintain operational dashboards (recurring KPIs, data hygiene, system adoption)

    • Advise with thought leadership on which tooling we procure next as we scale

  • Cross-functional partnership and enablement

    • Operational business partner to GTM leadership

    • Drive systems and process adoption across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnership teams through training and enablement

    • Act as first point of contact for revenue system support tickets

What success looks like in 12 months:

  • GTM signals are consistently translated into actionable workflows

  • Sellers and customer-facing teams spend materially less time on manual admin and prep

  • Critical revenue systems are connected, key workflows are AI-assisted or fully automated

  • Leadership has a real-time view into pipeline, conversion, execution, and customer health

You're a great fit if you:

  • 5+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations in a B2B SaaS hypergrowth environment

  • Deep hands-on expertise in CRM administration (HubSpot/Salesforce)

  • Proven track record building revenue systems, processes, and data flows from scratch

  • Persistent problem-solver at your core

  • Sharp entrepreneurial instincts and analytical mindset

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management

Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

The Business Unit (BU) President at Cordance is the strategic and operational leader of their business unit, serving as both its product and market authority and its executive anchor. As the P&L owner, the President is accountable for setting strategy, driving disciplined growth, and ensuring scalable and efficient operations. This role requires a leader with deep industry expertise, sharp understanding of customer needs, and the ability to balance long-term vision with hands-on execution.

The President will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, shape the product roadmap, establish the annual operating plan, and oversee resources and budgets to deliver sustainable business performance. They will champion customer experience, guide product strategy and engineering execution, and embed best practices in sales, pricing, packaging, customer success, and operational excellence.

As the primary external face of the BU to customers, strategic partners, and the broader industry, the President will engage deeply with stakeholders while mentoring internal teams, fostering a culture of accountability and innovation, and building high-performance organizations aligned with Cordance’s long-term objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership & Market Expertise
  • Serve as the primary product and market expert for the BU, with deep knowledge of customer needs, industry trends, and competitive dynamics.
  • Define and own the BU’s vision, objectives, and long-term growth strategy, aligning with Cordance’s portfolio priorities.
  • Develop and execute the annual operating plan and multi-year investment model, ensuring financial rigor and sustainable results.
  • Own full P&L responsibility, balancing growth initiatives with disciplined cost management.
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) & Product Strategy

  • Shape the product roadmap in alignment with market opportunities, customer feedback, and Cordance’s strategic framework.

  • Act as the external face of the BU and Cordance to customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
  • Integration & Operational Execution

  • Systems integration (data, platforms, shared services)
  • GTM integration (messaging, demand gen, sales alignment)
  • People integration (onboarding, organizational readiness, culture alignment)
  • Ensure milestones are met, risks are managed, and value creation targets are achieved during and after integration.
  • Drive operational excellence across engineering, product delivery, and customer-facing teams.
  • Team & People Leadership
  • Build, lead, and mentor high-performing teams that embody accountability, innovation, and collaboration.
  • Foster a culture of growth, customer obsession, and operational discipline within the BU.
  • Develop leadership talent and ensure organizational structures scale with business growth.
  • Serve as the primary external and internal leader for the BU, representing Cordance with employees, customers, partners, and within the broader industry ecosystem.

Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking & Vision: Defines long-term strategy and translates vision into actionable plans.
  • P&L & Financial Acumen: Manages financial performance, forecasting, budgeting, and value creation.
  • Execution Excellence: Drives accountability, operational discipline, and consistent delivery.
  • Decision-Making Under Ambiguity: Makes timely, informed decisions in complex or uncertain situations.
  • Change Leadership: Leads teams effectively through organizational change and transformation.
  • Industry & Market Expertise: Understands market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics.
  • Go-to-Market Leadership: Develops GTM strategies that drive sales execution and revenue growth.
  • Product Strategy & Roadmapping: Guides product priorities and investments based on market opportunities.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Keeps customer needs and experience central to business strategy.
  • Team Building & Talent Development: Builds, develops, and retains high-performing teams.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Aligns teams and functions to achieve shared business goals.
  • Culture Builder: Fosters trust, accountability, innovation, and high performance.
  • Communication & Influence: Communicates clearly and builds alignment across key stakeholders.
  • Post-Acquisition Integration: Integrates teams, systems, and GTM motions across acquired businesses.
  • Operational Excellence: Builds scalable processes and drives continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Management: Effectively balances the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Risk & Opportunity Assessment: Identifies risks early while recognizing and pursuing growth opportunities.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a President, General Manager, or senior P&L leader in a SaaS or B2B software environment.
  • Deep expertise in go-to-market strategy, product strategy, and customer success within a vertical SaaS or B2B context.
  • Strong track record of driving disciplined growth, scaling operations, and managing multi-million-dollar P&Ls.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead post-acquisition integrations, including systems, people, and GTM alignment.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a focus on building teams, mentoring talent, and fostering accountability.
  • Strong financial and operational acumen, with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision and short-term execution.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

What We Offer

  • A leadership role at the forefront of Cordance’s mission to grow and scale high-potential SaaS businesses.
  • The opportunity to shape strategy and execution for an entire business unit, backed by Cordance’s resources and operator community.
  • A collaborative culture that values entrepreneurial spirit, operational excellence, and long-term success.
  • Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and executive-level benefits.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

Instrument is a digitally native design and technology company built to help brands unlock their full potential. Since 2005, our team of makers, thinkers, and storytellers has partnered with leading brands like Google, Nike, Uber, ŌURA, and Eventbrite to craft digital experiences that create impact and drive results.

Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t just design—we build. Our work lives at the intersection of taste and technology, powered by curiosity, thoughtful curation, and a commitment to delivering the most fitting solution for every brief. We bring this to life across three core offerings: Brand, Marketing, and Product.

As a member of our freelance network, you’ll collaborate with our teams to bring bold ideas to life—whether launching new brands, building digital products, or shaping experiences that move people. We welcome collaborators from all backgrounds and experiences who share our curiosity, creativity, and care for craft.

We believe great work comes from diverse perspectives and shared purpose. If you’re passionate about learning, experimenting, and making work that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Role

We’re looking for an embedded, hands-on Creative Technologist to rapidly turn emerging AI capabilities into compelling, functional experiences.

Working closely with a multidisciplinary creative team, you’ll experiment with new AI model releases and capabilities, quickly moving from “what could we do with this?” to working prototypes and demos people actually want to engage with. You have your finger on the pulse of what’s happening across AI—following new launches, features, and the creative behaviors gaining traction, and recognizing opportunities to build while the conversation is happening.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who thrives in experimentation. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, curious about what’s next, and able to independently take an idea from early exploration through something polished enough to put in front of an audience.

Contract: ASAP – February 26, 2027
Commitment: 40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Stay deeply plugged into new AI launches, features, and emerging creative behaviors, identifying opportunities to build while the conversation is happening.
  • Rapidly concept, prototype, and ship AI-powered demos that showcase new model capabilities in timely, culturally relevant ways.
  • Turn technical capabilities into social-first demos and experiences that are immediately understandable, compelling, and designed to earn attention.
  • Use AI-assisted development, “vibe coding,” and rapid experimentation to move quickly from idea to working experience.
  • Experiment beyond the obvious use case, developing creative approaches, workflows, or reusable techniques that help others push a capability further.

Operations Risk Analyst

What We're Up To

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has over 1,900 markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.
  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Building a new category is hard… like, really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

As an Operations Risk Analyst, you’ll help ensure the stability and integrity of Kalshi’s markets by contributing to post-trade processing and managing operational risk across our exchange. You’ll monitor trading activity around the clock, safeguard customer positions, and serve as the first point of contact for clients and clearing members experiencing operational issues. You’ll play a key role in protecting participants, minimizing risk, and shaping the systems that power Kalshi’s next generation of markets.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee daily trade and clearing operations across Kalshi’s current and new markets, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance
  • Continuously monitor risk exposure, system performance, and operational controls; swiftly escalate and collaborate with engineering and risk teams to
    address and remediate issues
  • Identify operational risks proactively and contribute to the development and refinement of automated monitoring and exception-handling systems
  • Lead or participate in incident response, root-cause analyses, and post-mortems, ensuring actionable outcomes and continuous operational improvements
  • Partner cross-functionally with other teams to drive continuous improvement in risk management processes, documentation, and governance, enhancing
    Kalshi’s operational resilience and compliance posture
  • Support new clearing and risk initiatives aligned with Kalshi’s growth strategy and expansion into new markets and trading products

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field
  • Familiarity with clearing processes and operational risk management best practices
  • 1-2 years of experience in listed derivatives, repo, treasury, or OTC markets, ideally at a clearing house, trading firm, an exchange or a FCM
  • Strong analytical capabilities and technical proficiency, including advanced Excel/Google
  • Sheets skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, macros) and a basic understanding of financial technology systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of working effectively across technical and non-technical teams
  • Detail-oriented mindset with the ability to balance daily operational rigor and long-term risk strategy
  • Bonus: Experience working with clearing or exchange systems in a regulated environment
  • Bonus: Interest in financial innovation, derivatives, and the future of event-based trading

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.
  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Building a new category is hard… like, really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

As an Operations Risk Lead, you’ll help ensure the stability and integrity of Kalshi’s markets by overseeing post-trade processing and managing operational risk across our exchange. You’ll monitor trading activity around the clock, safeguard customer positions, and serve as the first point of contact for clients and clearing members experiencing operational issues. You’ll play a key role in protecting participants, minimizing risk, and shaping the systems that power Kalshi’s next generation of markets.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee daily trade and clearing operations across Kalshi’s current and new markets, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance
  • Serve as the primary contact for clients, brokers, and clearing members facing trade or system issues, ensuring fast resolution and clear communication
  • Continuously monitor risk exposure, system performance, and operational controls; swiftly escalate and collaborate with engineering and risk teams to
    address and remediate issues
  • Identify operational risks proactively and contribute to the development and refinement of automated monitoring and exception-handling systems
  • Lead or participate in incident response, root-cause analyses, and post-mortems, ensuring actionable outcomes and continuous operational improvements
  • Partner cross-functionally with other teams to drive continuous improvement in risk management processes, documentation, and governance, enhancing
    Kalshi’s operational resilience and compliance posture
  • Support new clearing and risk initiatives aligned with Kalshi’s growth strategy and expansion into new markets and trading products

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field
  • Familiarity with clearing processes and operational risk management best practices
  • 5-6 years of experience in listed derivatives, repo, treasury, or OTC markets, ideally at a clearing house, trading firm, an exchange or a FCM
  • Strong analytical capabilities and technical proficiency, including advanced Excel/Google
  • Sheets skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, macros) and a basic understanding of financial technology systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of working effectively across technical and non-technical teams
  • Detail-oriented mindset with the ability to balance daily operational rigor and long-term risk strategy
  • Bonus: Experience working with clearing or exchange systems in a regulated environment
  • Bonus: Interest in financial innovation, derivatives, and the future of event-based trading

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure:

Salary Range: $160,000 to $220,000 annually plus equity and benefits.
This salary range is based on the current available market data, and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to further discuss.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.
